    safe = re.sub(r'[\\/\x00]', '', session_id)

    import hashlib
    safe_hash = hashlib.sha256(safe.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    return safe_hash[:40] or "default"

def test_sessions_are_persisted_independently(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            save_turn(tmp, "A", "answer A", session_id="session-a")
            save_turn(tmp, "B", "answer B", session_id="session-b")
            session_a = load_history(tmp, session_id="session-a")
            session_b = load_history(tmp, session_id="session-b")
            assert [m.content for m in session_a] == ["A", "answer A"]
            assert [m.content for m in session_b] == ["B", "answer B"]

    # ---- 路径穿越安全测试 ----

    def test_safe_session_id_no_path_traversal(self):
        """session_id 包含 ../ 不应导致路径穿越。"""
        malicious_ids = [
            "../../../etc/passwd",
            "..\\..\\..\\windows\\system32",
            "sessions/../../evil",
            "a/b/c/../../../d",
            "\x00../../../etc/passwd",
            "normal\x00../evil",
        ]
        for sid in malicious_ids:
            safe = _safe_session_id(sid)
            # 结果必须是纯十六进制哈希，不含任何路径分隔符
            assert "/" not in safe, f"path separator found in safe id: {sid!r} -> {safe!r}"
            assert "\\" not in safe, f"backslash found in safe id: {sid!r} -> {safe!r}"
            assert ".." not in safe, f"dot-dot found in safe id: {sid!r} -> {safe!r}"
            assert len(safe) > 0
            # 应该是 hex 字符
            int(safe, 16)  # 如果非法会抛 ValueError

    def test_save_with_malicious_session_id_stays_in_project(self):
        """用恶意 session_id 写入的文件必须落在项目目录内。"""
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            malicious = "../../../tmp/escaped.json"
            save_turn(tmp, "test", "answer", session_id=malicious)
            # 确认文件确实写在了 .codepilot/sessions/ 下
            base = os.path.join(tmp, ".codepilot", "sessions")
            files = os.listdir(base)
            assert len(files) == 1
            # 文件名是十六进制哈希，不是原始 session_id
            assert not any(c in files[0] for c in ["/", "\\", ".."])
            # 确认能正常读取回来
            msgs = load_history(tmp, session_id=malicious)
            assert len(msgs) == 2
            assert msgs[0].content == "test"
            assert msgs[1].content == "answer"

    def test_same_malicious_session_id_is_deterministic(self):
        """相同的恶意 session_id 应映射到同一个安全 ID。"""
        sid = "../../../etc/passwd"
        assert _safe_session_id(sid) == _safe_session_id(sid)

    def test_different_session_ids_produce_different_hashes(self):
        """不同的 session_id 应产生不同的安全 ID。"""
        sid1 = "session-1"
        sid2 = "session-2"
        assert _safe_session_id(sid1) != _safe_session_id(sid2)
